scope: MEAS: independent checks/report comparison, published bar-map and visual/source review; not aural review.

report.finding: Reported gates, corrected endpoints, 3255 notes / five source parts and six-page 63-bar pack agree with final checks and published assets. The rejected 198.794 s cadence candidate is not presented as the final attack.

barMap.finding: All 3255 note bar/voice indices resolve, durations are positive and performed bar times strictly increase. Actual SVG bar identities equal index.json bars 1–63, with no derived boxes. Rendered pages 1 and 6 were inspected: the staggered opening string entries remain inside the written first bars and the closing fermata is a genuine bar 63. Listen cues use seconds, not structured bar pointers.

overlays.finding: No gross pitch/order mismatch identified in these final-candidate windows. The quiet opening at 0.58 s precedes the louder repeated bass. The corrected final arrival near 203.638 s follows, rather than compresses, the remaining dominant figures; the fermata's written duration maps to the estimated 207.34 s activity end, not a measured bow release.

version.finding: First movement alone, bars 1–63 once, with returning material already written out. Five source string/bass staves are retained. Figured bass is engraved without fabricating realised continuo or a separate double-bass part. No gross cut, transposition or arrangement mismatch identified in the inspected coverage.
version.physicalPerformingEdition: Unknown; the named edition identifies the symbolic source, not the performers’ physical parts.

limitations: MEAS: No aural review, build or browser integration check performed by VerS. Warped written durations and source-part labels are not independently recovered physical releases or isolated recorded stems.
